$comment: Build-time 3D→sprite jobs. `pnpm sprites` runs every one through Blender
Sources live in art-src/, which is GITIGNORED on purpose: bought models
(Fab, Unity Asset Store, Superhive) are licensed to be shipped inside a
product, not republished — and a web bundle is the one build where a .glb
is a download away. The rendered sprite is a 2D derivative; the model never
leaves this machine. Everything in the bundle is code-drawn or a PNG.
elev is fixed at 45°: that is the tilemap's projection (a 16px wall top
over a 16px wall face). Don't vary it per prop or props stop sharing a room.
anchor lands in shared/artManifest.ts — render-sprite.py measures the
model's ground contact and prints it into <out>.json after every render.
